materials.empty: Every probe gets BlockFunc_Free: a = $00, no position change.
materials.solid: BlockFunc_Solid: a = $01 and the probe's hYPosLo is snapped to a multiple of $10. Exception: a Wario wall probe (UNK4) while wWarioSlopeInteraction is set returns a = $00.
materials.platform: BlockFunc_Floor: solid to the standing probes (DOWN, UNK2); solid to the landing probes (UNK1, UNK6) only when hYPosLo & $0f < 5; free to the ceiling, wall, and presence probes.
materials.slope-right: RightSlopeCollision, rising to the right: DOWN and UNK1 probes only (UNK1 is free when x + y < $10 inside the block); hYPosLo becomes the block top + $10 - x; a = $10.
materials.slope-left: LeftSlopeCollision, rising to the left: DOWN and UNK1 probes only (UNK1 is free when x >= y inside the block); hYPosLo becomes the block top + x + 2; a = $10.
materials.slope-right-upper: Block above a right slope: only the DOWN probe collides, against the right slope one block lower.
materials.slope-right-lower: Block below a right slope: DOWN and UNK1 probes collide against the right slope one block higher; solid to Wario in WST_ATTACKING_AIRBORNE; otherwise free.
materials.slope-left-upper: Block above a left slope: only the DOWN probe collides, against the left slope one block lower.
materials.slope-left-lower: Block below a left slope: DOWN and UNK1 probes collide against the left slope one block higher; solid to Wario in WST_ATTACKING_AIRBORNE; otherwise free.

flags.ladder: Wario's presence probe (UNK7) sets wLadderInteraction = LADDER_COLLISION.
flags.ladder-top: Wario's presence probe (UNK7) sets wLadderInteraction = LADDER_UNDERNEATH and is free; other Wario probes and all object probes treat the block as a platform.
flags.door: Wario's presence probe with Up pressed in WST_IDLING, WST_SLIPPING, or WST_GRAB_IDLING sets wRoomTransitionParam to room_transition and runs EnterDoor.
flags.treasure-door: Any Wario probe with Up pressed, no transformation, in WST_IDLING, WST_SLIPPING, or WST_GRAB_IDLING clears wGrabState and sets wLevelEndScreen = LVLEND_NO_TREASURE. The probe kind is not checked.
flags.room-transition: Wario's presence probe (UNK7) sets wRoomTransitionParam to room_transition.
flags.zombie-passable: Free to Wario in WST_ZOMBIE_LANDING or WST_ZOMBIE_SLIPPING_THROUGH_FLOOR.
flags.breakable-cracked: CrackedBlockCollision: with wBlockFuncBreakFlag set, breaks on a wall probe while attacking or rolling, a ceiling probe with HEAD_SMASH_HELMET or better while jumping or swimming, or a landing probe; replaces the block with replacement_block (keeping bit 7). Robo-mouse special collisions also break or pass it.
flags.breakable-cracked-colour-coin: CrackedBlockWithColourCoinCollision: as breakable-cracked, without the robo-mouse checks, and calls BreakBlockWithColourCoin.
flags.breakable-non-cracked: NonCrackedBlockCollision: with wBlockFuncBreakFlag set, needs GARLIC or better (Fat Wario breaks it only with a landing probe); wall probe while attacking or rolling, ceiling probe with HEAD_SMASH_HELMET while jumping or swimming, or landing probe with SUPER_JUMP_SLAM_OVERALLS. Solid afterwards unless rolling.
flags.breakable-by-thrown-object: EnemyBlockCollision: solid; breaks only when wBlockFuncSpecialCollision is COLLISION_THROWN_OBJ.
flags.breakable-by-hot-wario: BonfireBlockCollision: solid; breaks for Wario as TRANSFORMATION_HOT_WARIO with wTransformationProgress >= 2.

06:413f: Wario in WST_ATTACKING_AIRBORNE -> BlockFunc_Solid; DOWN|UNK1: hYPos -= $10, then LeftSlopeCollision; otherwise free.
